tasks.title: Project Setup and Infrastructure
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository and set up core infrastructure components.
tasks.details:
1. Initialize a Git repository and set up a README with project details.
2. Configure Next.js 14 with TypeScript, ESLint, and Prettier.
3. Set up Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui components.
4. Create a Docker setup for PostgreSQL and configure Prisma ORM.
5. Establish a CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the project builds successfully and the development environment is correctly set up. Ensure Docker containers run without errors.

tasks.title: User Authentication System
tasks.description: Implement user authentication using email/password and OAuth providers.
tasks.details:
1. Use NextAuth.js for authentication.
2. Implement email/password login and registration.
3. Integrate OAuth with Google, GitHub, and Microsoft.
4. Set up two-factor authentication using TOTP.
5. Implement password reset and email verification flows.
tasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for authentication flows. Perform integration tests for OAuth providers and verify two-factor authentication functionality.

subtasks.title: Set Up NextAuth.js for Authentication
subtasks.description: Initialize NextAuth.js in the project for handling authentication.
subtasks.details: Install NextAuth.js and configure it in the application. Set up the basic authentication flow.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify NextAuth.js setup with a basic login flow.

subtasks.title: Implement Email/Password Login and Registration
subtasks.description: Develop the functionality for users to register and log in using email and password.
subtasks.details: Create API routes for registration and login. Store user credentials securely in the database.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for registration and login endpoints.

subtasks.title: Integrate OAuth with Google, GitHub, and Microsoft
subtasks.description: Add OAuth authentication using Google, GitHub, and Microsoft providers.
subtasks.details: Configure OAuth providers in NextAuth.js. Ensure proper callback handling and user session management.
subtasks.testStrategy: Perform integration tests for each OAuth provider.

subtasks.title: Set Up Two-Factor Authentication Using TOTP
subtasks.description: Implement two-factor authentication using Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP).
subtasks.details: Use a library like speakeasy to generate TOTP codes. Allow users to enable/disable two-factor authentication.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify TOTP setup and login flow with two-factor authentication.

subtasks.title: Implement Password Reset and Email Verification Flows
subtasks.description: Develop password reset and email verification functionalities.
subtasks.details: Create API routes for password reset and email verification. Send emails using a service like SendGrid.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test email sending and link handling for password reset and verification.

tasks.title: Rich Text Editor Integration
tasks.description: Integrate a WYSIWYG editor with support for rich text formatting and markdown shortcuts.
tasks.details:
1. Evaluate and select a suitable editor (TipTap, Quill, ProseMirror, or Draft.js).
2. Implement rich text formatting features (bold, italic, lists, etc.).
3. Add support for code blocks with syntax highlighting.
4. Enable markdown shortcuts for power users.
5. Implement auto-save functionality.
tasks.testStrategy: Test editor functionality across different browsers. Verify markdown shortcuts and auto-save feature.

subtasks.title: Evaluate and Select WYSIWYG Editor
subtasks.description: Research and choose a suitable WYSIWYG editor for integration.
subtasks.details: Evaluate TipTap, Quill, ProseMirror, and Draft.js based on project requirements and compatibility.
subtasks.testStrategy: Ensure selected editor meets all functional requirements.

subtasks.title: Implement Rich Text Formatting Features
subtasks.description: Integrate the selected editor and implement basic rich text formatting.
subtasks.details: Add support for bold, italic, underline, and list formatting using the editor's API.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify formatting features work as expected across browsers.

subtasks.title: Add Code Block Support with Syntax Highlighting
subtasks.description: Enable code block insertion with syntax highlighting in the editor.
subtasks.details: Use a library like Prism.js to add syntax highlighting to code blocks within the editor.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test code block rendering and syntax highlighting for multiple languages.

subtasks.title: Enable Markdown Shortcuts
subtasks.description: Implement markdown shortcuts for power users in the editor.
subtasks.details: Configure the editor to recognize markdown syntax and convert it to rich text automatically.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test markdown shortcuts for accuracy and ease of use.

subtasks.title: Implement Auto-Save Functionality
subtasks.description: Add auto-save feature to preserve user content periodically.
subtasks.details: Use local storage or a backend service to save editor content at regular intervals.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify auto-save triggers correctly and content is recoverable after a session ends.

tasks.title: Entry Management System
tasks.description: Develop CRUD operations for journal entries with template support.
tasks.details:
1. Implement API routes for creating, reading, updating, and deleting entries.
2. Add template support for new entries.
3. Implement entry metadata tracking (created, modified, author, word count).
4. Ensure entries are encrypted in the database.
tasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for each CRUD operation. Verify data encryption and metadata accuracy.

tasks.title: Category Management
tasks.description: Implement a system for managing categories with unlimited nesting and drag-and-drop reorganization.
tasks.details:
1. Develop API routes for category CRUD operations.
2. Implement a drag-and-drop interface for category management.
3. Allow multiple categories per entry and unlimited nesting.
4. Add category-specific icons and colors.
tasks.testStrategy: Test category creation, deletion, and reorganization. Verify drag-and-drop functionality and UI responsiveness.

tasks.title: Search and Discovery
tasks.description: Implement full-text search with advanced filters and fuzzy search capabilities.
tasks.details:
1. Set up PostgreSQL full-text search with pg_trgm extension.
2. Implement search API with filters for date range, category, and author.
3. Add fuzzy search for typo tolerance and real-time search suggestions.
4. Implement search history and saved queries.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform search performance tests. Validate search accuracy and filter functionality.

tasks.title: Version Control and History
tasks.description: Develop a version control system for entries with unlimited version retention and comparison views.
tasks.details:
1. Implement automatic version creation on entry save.
2. Develop a version comparison view with diff visualization.
3. Allow users to restore previous versions with confirmation.
4. Track version metadata (timestamp, author, change summary).
tasks.testStrategy: Test version creation and restoration processes. Verify diff visualization accuracy.

tasks.title: Workspace and Sharing Features
tasks.description: Implement workspace management and entry sharing with permissions.
tasks.details:
1. Develop support for multiple workspaces per user.
2. Implement personal and business workspace separation.
3. Create sharing functionality with permission levels (view, comment).
4. Develop a sharing activity log for compliance.
tasks.testStrategy: Test workspace creation and switching. Verify sharing permissions and activity logging.

tasks.title: File and Media Attachments
tasks.description: Enable file and media attachment support with encrypted storage.
tasks.details:
1. Implement file upload and embedding for images, documents, audio, and video.
2. Store files encrypted in PostgreSQL.
3. Add inline preview for supported file types.
4. Enforce file size limits configurable per deployment.
tasks.testStrategy: Test file upload and preview functionality. Verify encryption and storage limits.

tasks.title: Security and Privacy Enhancements
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive security measures including encryption and audit logging.
tasks.details:
1. Ensure data at rest encryption for the database.
2. Implement HTTPS/TLS for all data in transit.
3. Develop end-to-end encryption for entry content.
4. Set up an audit log system for security events and user activity tracking.
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct security audits and penetration tests. Verify encryption and audit log integrity.

subtasks.title: Implement Data at Rest Encryption
subtasks.description: Ensure encryption for data stored in the database.
subtasks.details: Use database-level encryption features to secure data at rest. Update configuration files to enable encryption.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify encryption by checking database configuration and performing data retrieval tests.

subtasks.title: Enable HTTPS/TLS for Data in Transit
subtasks.description: Implement HTTPS/TLS for all data transmitted between clients and servers.
subtasks.details: Configure the server to use HTTPS by obtaining and installing SSL/TLS certificates. Update server settings to enforce HTTPS connections.
subtasks.testStrategy: Conduct tests using tools like SSL Labs to verify HTTPS implementation and check for vulnerabilities.

subtasks.title: Develop End-to-End Encryption for Entry Content
subtasks.description: Implement encryption for entry content from client to server.
subtasks.details: Use libraries like CryptoJS to encrypt data on the client side before sending it to the server. Decrypt data on the server side as needed.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test encryption and decryption processes to ensure data integrity and security.

subtasks.title: Set Up Audit Log System
subtasks.description: Implement an audit log system to track security events and user activities.
subtasks.details: Integrate a logging library to capture and store logs of user actions and security events. Ensure logs are tamper-proof.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review logs for completeness and accuracy. Simulate security events to verify logging functionality.

subtasks.title: Conduct Security Audits and Penetration Tests
subtasks.description: Perform security audits and penetration tests to ensure system security.
subtasks.details: Engage with security professionals to conduct thorough audits and tests. Address any vulnerabilities found during testing.
subtasks.testStrategy: Document findings from audits and tests. Implement fixes for identified vulnerabilities.

tasks.title: Implement Import/Export Functionality
tasks.description: Develop the import/export capabilities for data portability.
tasks.details: Implement import functions for Evernote (.enex), Markdown, and HTML formats. Develop export functions for Markdown, PDF, HTML, and JSON. Ensure data integrity and handle bulk operations with progress indicators.
tasks.testStrategy: Test each import/export format with various data sets to ensure accuracy and completeness. Validate data integrity post-import/export.

subtasks.title: Analyze Existing Import/Export Code
subtasks.description: Review current codebase for any existing import/export functionalities.
subtasks.details: Use the Glob tool to locate files related to import/export, such as '*.js' or 'src/**/*.ts'. Use the Grep tool to search for keywords like 'import', 'export', 'Evernote', 'Markdown', 'HTML', 'PDF', and 'JSON'.

subtasks.title: Implement Evernote (.enex) Import Function
subtasks.description: Develop the import function for Evernote (.enex) files.
subtasks.details: Create a new module or extend an existing one to handle .enex file parsing. Ensure the data is correctly mapped to the application's data structure.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with various .enex files to ensure correct data import and integrity.

subtasks.title: Develop Markdown and HTML Import Functions
subtasks.description: Implement import functions for Markdown and HTML formats.
subtasks.details: Utilize existing libraries or write custom parsers to handle Markdown and HTML file imports. Ensure compatibility with the application's data model.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with diverse Markdown and HTML files to verify data integrity and completeness.

subtasks.title: Create Export Functions for Markdown, PDF, HTML, and JSON
subtasks.description: Develop export functionalities for Markdown, PDF, HTML, and JSON formats.
subtasks.details: Implement export logic that converts application data into the specified formats. Ensure data is accurately represented in each format.
subtasks.testStrategy: Export data in each format and verify the output matches the expected structure and content.

subtasks.title: Implement Bulk Operation Handling with Progress Indicators
subtasks.description: Ensure bulk import/export operations are handled efficiently with progress indicators.
subtasks.details: Develop a system to manage bulk operations, providing real-time progress feedback to users. Consider using asynchronous processing to enhance performance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test bulk operations with large datasets to ensure performance and accuracy, and verify progress indicators update correctly.

tasks.title: Develop MCP Server Integration
tasks.description: Integrate MCP server for AI assistant capabilities.
tasks.details: Implement MCP server with HTTP transport. Develop tools for CRUD operations and search via MCP. Ensure authentication and rate limiting are in place.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform integration tests to ensure MCP server handles requests correctly. Validate authentication and rate limiting.

tasks.title: Enhance Performance and Polish UI
tasks.description: Optimize performance and refine UI for production readiness.
tasks.details: Conduct load testing and optimize page load times, search response times, and entry save operations. Refine UI for mobile responsiveness and dark mode support.
tasks.testStrategy: Use performance testing tools to measure and optimize load times. Conduct usability testing across devices and browsers.

tasks.title: Implement Deferred Features
tasks.description: Add comments, notifications, 2FA, and user roles.
tasks.details: Develop comment system with threading, email notifications, two-factor authentication, and user role management (Admin, Editor, Viewer).
tasks.testStrategy: Unit and integration tests for each feature. Validate security for 2FA and role-based access controls.

tasks.title: Develop Plugin System
tasks.description: Create a plugin architecture for extensibility.
tasks.details: Design and implement a plugin API with lifecycle hooks and a permission model. Develop example plugins and a marketplace for discovery.
tasks.testStrategy: Test plugin installation, execution, and security. Validate sandboxing and permission enforcement.

tasks.title: Implement Theme System
tasks.description: Develop a theme system for UI customization.
tasks.details: Create a structure for theme customization using Tailwind CSS. Implement a marketplace for theme distribution and management.
tasks.testStrategy: Test theme application and customization across different UI components. Validate compatibility with existing UI elements.

tasks.title: Conduct Security Audit and Enhancements
tasks.description: Perform a comprehensive security audit and implement enhancements.
tasks.details: Conduct a security audit focusing on OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities. Implement necessary security enhancements and regular dependency updates.
tasks.testStrategy: Use automated security scanning tools and manual reviews to identify vulnerabilities. Validate fixes through penetration testing.

tasks.title: Finalize Documentation and Guides
tasks.description: Complete user and developer documentation.
tasks.details: Finalize user guides, API documentation, and developer setup guides. Ensure comprehensive coverage of all features and integration points.
tasks.testStrategy: Review documentation for accuracy and completeness. Conduct user testing to ensure guides are clear and helpful.

tasks.title: Setup Community and Governance Structures
tasks.description: Establish community forums and governance for open-source collaboration.
tasks.details: Set up community forums using Discourse or GitHub Discussions. Define governance structures and contribution guidelines.
tasks.testStrategy: Monitor community engagement and feedback. Ensure governance processes are clear and effective.

tasks.title: Prepare for Public Launch
tasks.description: Finalize preparations for the public launch of OpenJournal.
tasks.details: Complete final testing, marketing materials, and launch strategy. Ensure all systems are ready for public access.
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct a final review of all systems and processes. Validate readiness through a soft launch or beta testing phase.
